n, k, p = map(int, input().split())

def pow_mod(base, exp, mod):
    res = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return res

if n % 2 == 1:
    print(pow_mod(k, n, p))
    exit()

factorial = [1] * (n + 1)
inv_factorial = [1] * (n + 1)

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    factorial[i] = (factorial[i - 1] * i) % p

inv_factorial[n] = pow_mod(factorial[n], p - 2, p)

for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
    inv_factorial[i] = (inv_factorial[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % p

g = [[0] * 17 for _ in range(n + 1)]
g[0][0] = 1

count = 0

def dfs(n, bits, idx, mask):
    global count
    if idx == len(bits):
        count += 1
        for i in range(1, 17):
            g[n][i] += inv_factorial[mask] * g[n ^ mask][i - 1]
            if count >= 8:
                g[n][i] %= p
        if count >= 8:
            count = 0
        return
    dfs(n, bits, idx + 1, mask)
    dfs(n, bits, idx + 1, mask ^ (1 << bits[idx]))

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    if (i & n) != i:
        continue
    bits = []
    for j in range(18):
        if (1 << j) & i:
            bits.append(j)
    dfs(i, bits, 0, 1 << bits[0])

total_sum = 0
for i in range(1, min(17, k + 1)):
    g[n][i] %= p
    val = factorial[n] * g[n][i] % p
    val = val * factorial[k] % p
    val = val * inv_factorial[k - i] % p
    total_sum += val
    total_sum %= p

total_pow = pow_mod(k, n, p)
final_result = total_pow - total_sum
if final_result < 0:
    final_result += p

print(final_result)
